text:
Anika: Quick sync from today's all-hands Q&A about APAC launch and autoscaler. Dropping answers and follow-ups here.
Diego: Short version: APAC pilot opens in two weeks. We focused on predictable pockets of capacity in SIN + TOK before broadening.
Jamal: Can you call out which customers get early access? I had a few enterprise customers ask.
Diego: We'll invite customers on existing Dedicated contracts + a handful of PLG pilot partners. PMs will get the invite list by EOD.
Priya: Note on autoscaler behavior: autoscaler v1.2 uses locality-first decisions. It tries local reserved -> local burst -> sibling APAC -> fallback to US-multi as last resort.
Anika: How does "burst" differ from "reserved" in practice?
Priya: Burst = spot-backed shared pool for Hosted. Reserved = Dedicated capacity tied to a customer's commitment. Burst can be reclaimed by provider.
Jamal: If a burst node is reclaimed mid-inference, what happens to requests in-flight?
Diego: We have a graceful drain window (~20s) and continuous KV-cache snapshotting to reduce repeat work. If reclaimed abruptly, request fails with 502 and autoscaler retries to next fallback with trace id.
Anika: Customers worried about data residency. Any controls?
Priya: Yes — route config supports a flag `data_residency: strict` (sample below). When set, autoscaler will NOT route outside region and will return 429 with `x-rdi-reason: residency-block` when capacity isn't available.
Anika: paste sample config please
Priya: ```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "data_residency": "strict"
}
```
Diego: Billing note: cross-region failover will surface estimated egress in Console. We won't auto-bill unknown charges without explicit opt-in for cross-region fallback.
Jamal: Any changes to dry-run / cost projection APIs?
Diego: Console will add a 'burst estimate' toggle to billing previews. We'll also emit a `burst_estimate` field in the usage API for the pilot.
Anika: What about cold starts in SIN?
Priya: Target cold node provision <= 90s. Model load depends: small models ~20s, medium ~30-40s, LLM-70B up to 80s. We'll pre-warm hot models based on recent traffic heuristics.
Jamal: Action items for eng teams?
Priya: (1) Schema PR: add `data_residency` enum by Thu COB. (2) Observability: tag cold-start events with `region` + `model_variant` (SRE). (3) Billing: add burst-estimate UI mock by next sprint.
Anika: Who owns the PR for the schema?
Diego: I'll open it and tag @eng-api.
deploy-bot: Starting canary deployment: autoscaler v1.2 -> 10% traffic.
Jamal: Small ask: add one-liner FAQ for customers: "What if my workload hits spot eviction?" That helped last time.
Diego: Will add FAQ: short answer — failover to reserved or sister-region, include trace id and clear explanation in Console.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment successful. Autoscaler v1.2 at 10% -> green.
Anika: Thanks all. I'll collect the PR links and customer comms draft and share in #product-announcements later today. If anyone has follow-ups, ping me directly.
